title: Very Roasted Russian Beef Noodles
description: A hearty and comforting Russian dish featuring roasted beef, rice stick noodles, and fresh vegetables, perfect for a sick day. This recipe is raw-friendly and can be easily customized to suit your taste.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef brisket with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef brisket until browned on all sides.
Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 3 hours or until tender.
Cook the rice stick noodles according to the package instructions.
Slice the roasted beef and serve with the noodles and vegetables.
